reviewer: Codex assistant; not independent human gold
scope: Earlier generation fidelity to the human root. Later edit fidelity must also be judged against its immediate model parent. No source reselection or training change follows these findings.

notes: The parent changes enjoying mathematics to excelling at it and adds quickly to the discovery of navigation errors.
It recasts the crew's slow understanding as resistance, especially from Lem Harvey; the root does not establish that resistance.
It calls Little Johnny a young sailor and attributes engagement and competence to the sextant experience without source support.
It adds a causal explanation linking dedication and precision to the honorary degree. The broad plot, institutions and nine-year apprenticeship remain.
The parent omits the alternate names and the explicit internal-perspective test-design description, including expected outputs.
It broadens the electrical analogy from circuit nodes to each connection and node.
It strengthens assessment for missing or unimplemented requirements under design-driven methods to effectively uncovering them.
The parent adds an explanation of code-coverage measures to a root ending at the introduction of a list. Its internal-versus-external distinction and test levels otherwise remain recognizable.

The parent strengthens the suggested sensitivity advantage of faecal samples to a demonstrated higher sensitivity, and sometimes describes detection of the virus where the root specifically reports DNA.
It changes nearby aviaries to co-housing and adds a limited-cross-species-transmission interpretation.
It gives the chick-survival correlation a lower-survival direction absent from the root.
It omits some geographic and recapture details. The bird counts, assay, shedding interval, adult comparison and unknown infection source are retained.
The parent locates the party's confirmation in Brussels although the root locates Tshisekedi there, and omits Wednesday, the two-year medical stay and July return.
It changes elections failing to materialize to cancellation, and replaces four prime-minister appointments with several.
It changes the declared 2011 winner to an unqualified election victory.
It moves exile under Laurent Kabila to after the 2011 contest and adds that Kasai is near Kinshasa. It also loses part of the mythical-sphinx explanation of the nickname.
